name: Dev Team
purpose: Keeps the machine under everything running: your repo, your live site, your database, your keys, and the checks that keep them safe.

seats.name: API Manager
seats.detail: Owns the doors. Every tool the department talks to (connectors, APIs, CLIs) is a door, and this team member knows which doors exist, who uses each, and whether they still open. The keys agent HOLDS the keys; this team member decides which doors get wired and keeps the roster honest.

seats.name: Code Reviewer
seats.detail: Reads what got built before it gets saved. The test agent runs things; this team member reads the changes themselves, the second pair of eyes a solo owner doesn't have.

seats.name: GitHub Agent
seats.detail: Keeps your work saved and your history safe. Every save is a point you can come back to. That's the undo rule: a bad edit to a file here is a step backwards, not a loss. What it does not undo is anything that already left your machine, like a page a stranger already visited or an email that already sent.

seats.name: Keys Agent
seats.detail: Holds the keys. Every key lives in one env file the repo already knows to skip when saving, so your keys don't ride along to GitHub. That covers the GitHub door. It doesn't cover a key pasted somewhere else, so keep that file private and off shared folders.

seats.name: Payments Agent
seats.detail: For the day you're ready to take money on your pages. Checkout links, a paid product, a deposit on a call. Arrives as a drop, with its own setup and its own guardrails.

seats.name: Planner
seats.detail: Plans before anything gets built. Turns "I want X" into one short plan you can read in a minute: what's about to happen, what it touches, what the undo is. Nothing on this team runs until the plan gets your yes.

seats.name: Security Checker
seats.detail: Sweeps for anything leaking before it can cost you: a key in the wrong place, a form that tells strangers too much, a door left open.

seats.name: Supabase Agent
seats.detail: The filing cabinet your tools can reach any time: data that needs to live online, not in a file. Most departments don't need it in week one, and that's fine; it sits connected and ready.

seats.name: Test Agent
seats.detail: Tries to break what the department builds, before anyone else can. A page before it goes live, a key after setup, a routine before it runs on a schedule.

seats.name: Vercel Agent
seats.detail: Puts your pages on the live internet. Free plan covers everything this department does for a long time.
